Detailed Description

📊 Status screen display and management for server/discovery service modes

Manages periodic display of status information including:

  • Session string (memorable 3-word string)
  • Bind addresses (IPv4 and IPv6)
  • Connected client/server count
  • Server uptime

The status screen is updated periodically from the TCP server accept loop via callback and can be disabled with --no-status-screen flag.

            Periodically update status display with live logs at FPS rate.
            Gathers and displays status with live log feed if enough time has
            passed since last update (based on
            GET_OPTION(fps)). Updates at 60 Hz by default.
